caption: The drawing shows a tall wooden cabinet with a rectangular form, consisting of two main sections. The upper section has two doors with clear glass panels; the glass is arranged in a geometric pattern with diamond and rectangular shapes, and the area behind the glass is colored in light blue and pale beige tones, suggesting the presence of inner shelves. The wood around the glass is light brown with a natural grain. The lower section features a row of drawers, with the top row containing four smaller drawers, each having a round brass-colored knob. The central portion of this row has oval and circular inlays in a reddish-brown wood tone with a distinctive figuring, bordered by triangular and diamond shapes in contrasting wood tones. Below this, there are three full-width drawers, each with two round brass-colored knobs, and the wood here has a continuous light brown grain. The base of the cabinet has a scalloped trim, and a line drawing beneath the cabinet shows a cross-section with additional drawers and arched decorative elements. The entire cabinet is set against an off-white background.
title: Combination Book Case, Desk, and Bureau
